name: Multi-pass Blending
aliases: Hardware Polygon Blending with Quadratic Approximation
definition: A technique to approximate correct intensity and opacity using hardware polygon rendering by using quadratic functions for color/alpha interpolation and the blend function 'one minus source alpha' to handle background attenuation.
summary: Multi-pass blending approximates exponential opacity decay using three hardware rasterization passes, replacing linear interpolation with quadratic accuracy for correct volume rendering.
